en_how: Cold charcoal evidence desk uniting Pinglu Canal Madao Hub 5,000t ship-trial drone footage, dry-excavation & origin photographs, and the 134.2 km cascade water-level CSV profile on one shared timeline; opens with a live-footage white-flash freeze, red circle and 2x pixel loupe before rewinding into a 3-source sync grid, moving into a paper transcription card with signal-red highlighter linked by dashed lines to live lock surge footage and a water-saving basin schematic, ending on a multi-source evidence map with Kokoro narration.
